description: This file defines a mock content repository for an Android TV application, providing sample media categories and items for development/testing purposes.

classes.name: MockContentRepository
classes.description: A class that provides in-memory, mock media content for the app's UI, simulating a data source.

methods.name: getHomeCategories
methods.description: Returns a list of media categories containing sample media items for featured content, movies, and live TV.

methods.name: sampleVod
methods.description: Creates a sample Video-On-Demand media item with specified id, title, and URL.

methods.name: sampleLive
methods.description: Creates a sample live stream media item with specified id, title, and URL.
